HDS-001.summary: The byte-pinned official V2.1 publication, visible pages 7-10 and official VDV-301-2.1 repository inventory independently confirm that HTMLDisplayService intentionally has no dedicated service XSD and is a DNS-SD/HTTP profile. The current RV-002 rerun confirms the V2.1 discovery profile and endpoint construction without applying V2.2+ discovery rules retroactively.

deduplication: No new HDS V2.1 finding ID opened; the independent fresh-read result reconciles to HDS-001.
